content.text:
The Techno-Z Salzburg site is a technology park and office campus in Itzling, not a dedicated data centre. The only data-centre listing I found is a directory entry with no area figure.

**Year:** The first building at the Itzling site began operating in 1988.

citations.cited_text:
June 28 1988: the first Techno-Z facility opens with building Techno 1 in Salzburg Itzling

17 facilities within 11 years.
citations.title: Milestones - Techno-Z

content.text: The first Techno-Z facility opened on June 28, 1988, with building Techno 1 in Salzburg Itzling.
The operator's company page gives the same year for the first location. A supercomputer was also put into service at the site in 1989, but that is not the opening year.

citations.cited_text: 1989 wurde der Supercomputer in Betrieb genommen, der damals als der schnellste nicht-universitäre Rechner in Österreich galt.
citations.title: 30 Jahre Techno-Z: Jetzt wird gebaut - Salzburg-Stadt

content.text: The supercomputer went into operation in 1989 and was then considered the fastest non-university computer in Austria.
**Area:** I could not find a building, white-space or plot area for this facility. The company's 44,000 m² figure covers all its locations, not just Salzburg.

citations.cited_text:

**Five locations:** Salzburg city (1988), Bischofshofen (1989), Saalfelden (1990), Mariapfarr (1999)

**Size:** 44,000 m² ...

content.text: Size: 44,000 m² of office and commercial space

is the group-wide total, so I did not use it. The Techno Head building (5,800 m² gross floor area, completion planned for 2027) is a new, unfinished building, so it is not counted either.
